column1: # Sonic Superstars (SEGA / Arzest, update 1.1.8 over the base game), SDK 16.2.0, NVN, Unity 2021.3.25f1 IL2CPP, CRIWARE (ADX2 sound, USM movies), FMOD.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; brought up on the Mac with its names and stdalloc_cap added (README.md).

# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# StandardAllocator::Initialize(nullptr, 3.12 GB) from nninitStartup (returning to main+0x1cb71d0) gets 1.5 GB of address space: it maps 0.38 GB of it by the first stage, while
# Unity's own regions (main+0x4169c) hold 1.34 GB live and reach 2.2 GB past it. With the whole 3.12 GB they ran out of the iPhone's 4.38 GB alias region in the first stage's load
# (a write at 0xffffe0, main+0x18a2a30); see README.md, Memory
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# heap check: 2026-11-07, no heap set; set depth_mode

# address regions: 2026-11-07, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +4.07 GB, within the profile's 4.38 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite 5f7ada8659c9)
